snippet.title: Super Mario Bros. Friends - Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Finally, I've completed the game after working 18 hours per day(that is way too long) completing all 18 levels (Switch Palace is NOT counted), fixing bugs, and preparing for the coming expo.

As of now, this is a demo, and the full game will be released afterward (no date fixed)...

THIS GAME IS AVAILABLE FOR DOWNLOAD!!!!

Itch.io:
https://winmithul.itch.io/my-friend-mario

MFGG:
https://mfgg.net/index.php?act=resdb&param=02&c=2&id=40330

SFGHQ:
https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/my-friend-mario-is-now-super-mario-bros-friends.1843/

Play the game, comment, and share this with everyone. And also give a review so that I can improve this game...

SONG USED:
Track: JOXION - Getting Down [Arcade Release]
Music from Arcade by NoCopyrightSounds.
Watch: http://ncs.lnk.to/gettingdownAT/youtube
Free Download / Stream: http://ncs.io/gettingdown
